		private EventHandler varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler
		{
			get
			{
				if (_varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler == null)
				{
					_varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler = delegate
					{
						if (_needUpdateCombos)
						{
							UpdateComboboxes();
						}
					};
				}
				return _varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				switch (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.THROAT_SHAPE", "value")))
				{
				case "ROUND":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboThroatShape_var1.Value", (object)"Round");
					break;
				case "ANNULAR":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboThroatShape_var1.Value", (object)"Annular gap");
					break;
				case "SQUARE":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboThroatShape_var1.Value", (object)"Square");
					break;
				case "RECTANGULAR":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboThroatShape_var1.Value", (object)"Rectangular");
					break;
				}
				UpdateComboboxes();
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		private void UpdateComboboxes()
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (varOptDependencies != null)
			{
				varOptDependencies.PropertyDependencyChanged -= varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler;
			}
			if (varOptDependencies != null)
			{
				varOptDependencies.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				varOptDependencies = new CxvPropertyWatch();
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.PHASEP_OPT", "value", (string)null, varOptDependencies));
			_needUpdateVar = false;
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("SpecOpt2"));
			switch (text)
			{
			case "SPLP":
				if (text2 == "Solid load of vapor outlet")
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Solid load of vapor outlet");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Fraction of solids to solid outlet");
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Fraction of solids to solid outlet");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Solid load of vapor outlet");
				}
				break;
			case "SPLL":
				if (text2 == "Vapor load of solid outlet")
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Vapor load of solid outlet");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Fraction of solids to solid outlet");
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Fraction of solids to solid outlet");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Vapor load of solid outlet");
				}
				break;
			case "SPSL":
				if (text2 == "Fraction of vapor to vapor outlet")
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Fraction of vapor to vapor outlet");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Fraction of solids to solid outlet");
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Fraction of solids to solid outlet");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Fraction of vapor to vapor outlet");
				}
				break;
			case "LPSL":
				if (text2 == "Fraction of vapor to vapor outlet")
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Fraction of vapor to vapor outlet");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Solid load of vapor outlet");
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Solid load of vapor outlet");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Fraction of vapor to vapor outlet");
				}
				break;
			case "LLSL":
				if (text2 == "Fraction of vapor to vapor outlet")
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Fraction of vapor to vapor outlet");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Vapor load of solid outlet");
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Vapor load of solid outlet");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Fraction of vapor to vapor outlet");
				}
				break;
			}
			_needUpdateVar = true;
			if (!varOptDependencies.IsEmpty)
			{

		private EventHandler varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler
		{
			get
			{
				if (_varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler == null)
				{
					_varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler = delegate
					{
						if (_needUpdateCombos)
						{
							UpdateComboboxes();
						}
					};
				}
				return _varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			UpdateComboboxes();
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OPT_SUBPSD", "value")) == "OVERALL" && CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SPEC_OVOPT.@SUBDISTID2", "value")) == "MGGS")
			{
				switch (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OV_DISTFUN.@SUBDISTID2", "value")))
				{
				case "RRSB":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SPEC_OVOPT.@SUBDISTID2", "value", (object)"D63RRSB");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
					break;
				case "LOG-NORMAL":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SPEC_OVOPT.@SUBDISTID2", "value", (object)"D63GMV");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
					break;
				case "NORMAL":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SPEC_OVOPT.@SUBDISTID2", "value", (object)"D63SV");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
					break;
				}
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		private void UpdateComboboxes()
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Expected O, but got Unknown

				varOptDependencies.PropertyDependencyChanged -= varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler;
			}
			if (varOptDependencies != null)
			{
				varOptDependencies.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				varOptDependencies = new CxvPropertyWatch();
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OPT_SUBPSD", "value"));

				string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("SpecOpt2"));

		private EventHandler varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler
		{
			get
			{
				if (_varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler == null)
				{
					_varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler = delegate
					{
						if (_needUpdateCombos)
						{
							UpdateComboboxes();
						}
					};
				}
				return _varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			UpdateComboboxes();
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OPT_SUBPSD", "value")) == "OVERALL" && CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SPEC_OVOPT.@SUBDISTID2", "value")) == "MGGS")
			{
				switch (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OV_DISTFUN.@SUBDISTID2", "value")))
				{
				case "RRSB":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SPEC_OVOPT.@SUBDISTID2", "value", (object)"D63RRSB");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
					break;
				case "LOG-NORMAL":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SPEC_OVOPT.@SUBDISTID2", "value", (object)"D63GMV");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
					break;
				case "NORMAL":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SPEC_OVOPT.@SUBDISTID2", "value", (object)"D63SV");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
					break;
				}
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		private void UpdateComboboxes()
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (varOptDependencies != null)
			{
				varOptDependencies.PropertyDependencyChanged -= varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler;
			}
			if (varOptDependencies != null)
			{
				varOptDependencies.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				varOptDependencies = new CxvPropertyWatch();
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OPT_SUBPSD", "value"));
			if (text == "SUBSID")
			{
				string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SPEC_SUBOPT.@SUBATTRID.@SUBDISTID", "value", (string)null, varOptDependencies));
				_needUpdateVar = false;
				string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("SpecOptSubDist2"));
				switch (text2)
				{
				case "D63GGS":
					if (text3 == "D63")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"GGS Dispersion parameter");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D63");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"D63");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"GGS Dispersion parameter");
					}
					break;
				case "MGGS":
					if (text3 == "Maximum particle diameter")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"GGS Dispersion parameter");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Maximum particle diameter");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Maximum particle diameter");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"GGS Dispersion parameter");
					}
					break;
				case "D63D50":
					if (text3 == "D63")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"D50");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D63");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"D63");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D50");
					}
					break;
				case "MD50":
					if (text3 == "Maximum particle diameter")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"D50");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Maximum particle diameter");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Maximum particle diameter");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D50");
					}
					break;
				case "D50GGS":
					if (text3 == "D50")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"GGS Dispersion parameter");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D50");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"D50");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"GGS Dispersion parameter");
					}
					break;
				case "MD63":
					if (text3 == "Maximum particle diameter")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"D63");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Maximum particle diameter");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Maximum particle diameter");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D63");
					}
					break;
				case "D50EDER":
					if (text3 == "D50")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Steepness");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D50");
					}
					else

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate || _needUpdateCombos)
			{
				switch (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.DRYER_TYPE", "value")))
				{
				case "SHORTCUT":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboType_var1.Value", (object)"Shortcut dryer");
					break;
				case "CONVECTIVE":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboType_var1.Value", (object)"Convective dryer");
					break;
				case "SPRAY":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboType_var1.Value", (object)"Spray dryer");
					break;
				}
				UpdateComboboxes();
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		private void SetTabAccessible()
		{
			if (!(((MMViewModel)this).View is MMDryer_Result mMDryer_Result))
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Output.HAS_BATCH", "value"));
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				if (lastBalanceVisbilty.Equals("0"))
				{
					((UIElement)(object)mMDryer_Result.tab1).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					((UIElement)(object)mMDryer_Result.tab6).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				else
				{
					((UIElement)(object)mMDryer_Result.tab1).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					((UIElement)(object)mMDryer_Result.tab6).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
			else if (text.Equals("0"))
			{
				lastBalanceVisbilty = text;
				((UIElement)(object)mMDryer_Result.tab1).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				((UIElement)(object)mMDryer_Result.tab6).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			else
			{
				lastBalanceVisbilty = text;
				((UIElement)(object)mMDryer_Result.tab1).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				((UIElement)(object)mMDryer_Result.tab6).Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
		}

	public class SmallValueToZeroConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				double? num = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(value);
				if (num.HasValue && Math.Abs(num.Value) < 1E-12)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				if (num == 1E+35)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

		private EventHandler varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler
		{
			get
			{
				if (_varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler == null)
				{
					_varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler = delegate
					{
						if (_needUpdateCombos)
						{
							UpdateComboboxes();
						}
					};
				}
				return _varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			UpdateComboboxes();
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OPT_SUBPSD", "value")) == "OVERALL" && CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SPEC_OVOPT.@SUBDISTID2", "value")) == "MGGS")
			{
				switch (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OV_DISTFUN.@SUBDISTID2", "value")))
				{
				case "RRSB":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SPEC_OVOPT.@SUBDISTID2", "value", (object)"D63RRSB");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
					break;
				case "LOG-NORMAL":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SPEC_OVOPT.@SUBDISTID2", "value", (object)"D63GMV");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
					break;
				case "NORMAL":
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SPEC_OVOPT.@SUBDISTID2", "value", (object)"D63SV");
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
					break;
				}
			}
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
		}

		private void UpdateComboboxes()
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (varOptDependencies != null)
			{
				varOptDependencies.PropertyDependencyChanged -= varOptDependencies_PropertyDependencyChangedHandler;
			}
			if (varOptDependencies != null)
			{
				varOptDependencies.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				varOptDependencies = new CxvPropertyWatch();
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OPT_SUBPSD", "value"));
			if (text == "SUBSID")
			{
				string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SPEC_SUBOPT.@SUBATTRID.@SUBDISTID", "value", (string)null, varOptDependencies));
				_needUpdateVar = false;
				string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("SpecOpt2"));
				switch (text2)
				{
				case "D63GGS":
					if (text3 == "D63")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"GGS Dispersion parameter");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D63");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"D63");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"GGS Dispersion parameter");
					}
					break;
				case "MGGS":
					if (text3 == "Maximum particle diameter")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"GGS Dispersion parameter");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Maximum particle diameter");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Maximum particle diameter");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"GGS Dispersion parameter");
					}
					break;
				case "D63D50":
					if (text3 == "D63")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"D50");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D63");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"D63");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D50");
					}
					break;
				case "MD50":
					if (text3 == "Maximum particle diameter")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"D50");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Maximum particle diameter");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Maximum particle diameter");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D50");
					}
					break;
				case "D50GGS":
					if (text3 == "D50")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"GGS Dispersion parameter");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D50");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"D50");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"GGS Dispersion parameter");
					}
					break;
				case "MD63":
					if (text3 == "Maximum particle diameter")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"D63");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Maximum particle diameter");
					}
					else
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Maximum particle diameter");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D63");
					}
					break;
				case "D50EDER":
					if (text3 == "D50")
					{
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var1.Value", (object)"Steepness");
						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"D50");

						((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("cboSpecOpt_var2.Value", (object)"Steepness");
					}

								text += text7;
							}
						}
					}
					result = text;
					if (!watch.IsEmpty)
					{
						watch.PropertyDependencyChanged += watch_PropertyDependencyChanged;
					}
					return result;
				}
			}

		}

		{

			{
				switch (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OV_DISTFUN.@SUBDISTID2", "value")))
				{
				case "RRSB":

			}
